meta.one_liner: Buy quality stocks on sharp 2-day dips, sell the bounce. A Larry Connors classic.
meta.explainer_md: RSI-2 is a very fast 'oversold' meter: when it drops below 10, the stock has fallen hard for a couple of days. This strategy buys those dips — but only in stocks trading above their 200-day average, so you're buying pullbacks in healthy uptrends, not falling knives. It sells as soon as price closes back above its 5-day average. Lots of small, quick trades.

spec.name: RSI-2 Mean Reversion
spec.description: Connors-style: rsi_2 < 10 in an uptrend, exit on close > sma_5.
